DF_PARTICLE_EFFECTS.TypeHint: Visual natural fire clipped to this region. It does not deal damage or change tokens.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.hint: Turn this fire on or off without deleting the behavior. The region's own Disabled checkbox also hides it.

effectType.label: Effect Type
effectType.hint: Natural Fire is the only effect in this version. Later effects can be added here without a new behavior type.

density.label: Density
density.hint: How many flame sites to place for this region's area, counted in grid cells. 0 hides the flames. This does not follow the browser window size.

flameScale.label: Flame Scale
flameScale.hint: Size of each flame relative to the scene grid. The flame base stays on the ground.

flameSpeed.label: Flame Speed
flameSpeed.hint: How fast flicker, sway, and rising embers move.

opacity.label: Opacity
opacity.hint: Overall opacity of flames and embers.

emberAmount.label: Ember Amount
emberAmount.hint: How many rising sparks to draw, relative to the number of flames. 0 disables sparks.

edgeFade.label: Edge Fade
edgeFade.hint: 0 keeps a hard edge. Higher values fade flames whose base sits near the boundary. Sprites are still masked to the region, including holes.

randomSeed.label: Random Seed
randomSeed.hint: Leave empty or 0 to keep a stable layout derived from this scene, region, and behavior. Any other number reshuffles only this fire.

quality.name: Fire quality
quality.hint: Caps flames and embers per region and per scene. Lower this if a very large fire region drops frames. The saved region settings do not change.
